lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Karu! Machang! You made it! Come, come,  sit. Amma called me, I told her you would be fine. Did you eat anything on the bus? Sit.

Uncle Sirisena's living room is exactly as Amma described. Four calendars on the wall. Three of them have different politicians' faces. One has a scenic waterfall, which he has probably also voted for at some point.

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: You arrived on a very important day. Election is coming. Six weeks. This country,  anything can happen in six weeks.

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: Are you registered to vote? You must be registered. Your generation,  nobody registers. Then they complain. You are not that type, no?

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.text: I am in a very important WhatsApp group. Alupotha Patriots. 847 members. Very active.

card.message: ‼️ URGENT: Voter registration closes THIS WEEK. If you are not registered by Friday you cannot vote. Share with everyone you know before it is too late. 🙏🙏🙏

lines.speaker: Uncle Sirisena
lines.prompt: See! Registration closes THIS week! What do you do?

choices.label: Forward it to your contacts immediately.
Go check the Elections Commission notice board first.
Ask Uncle where this message came from.
Say nothing. Deal with it later.
